_: Xfinity channel numbers around Seattle Center: the 'Xfinity King County South' lineup (tvtv.us lineup USA-WA63873-X, ZIP 98109), the basic number per station call sign (the HD copies sit in the 600s and 1200s; an X1 box tunes HD from the basic number). tvtv.us sits behind Cloudflare, so this is fetched in a browser, not by the cron — see scripts/xfinity-lineup.mjs for the snippet — then applied to site/channels.json with `node scripts/xfinity-lineup.mjs`.
